sources.title: suomi.fi
highlights: If you aim to live in Finland for more than six months, you must register at the Digital and Population Data Services Agency

sources.title: ihhelsinki.fi
highlights: When you do this, you will also receive a personal identity code
What you need before this step

If you are moving to Finland until further notice you should register a permanent address, because with a temporary address you cannot receive a municipality of residence in Finland, which means you are not entitled to public services

sources.title: dvv.fi
highlights: Anyone moving from another Nordic country must visit our service location personally and prove their identity
Bring a valid identity card showing your nationality, such as a passport

sources.title: tampere.fi
highlights: If you don’t have a personal identity code, you can get one in the same appointment

sources.title: nordicexpat.com
highlights: Book the appointment the day you land, even if you submit the form later
If you have flexibility, check DVV's online booking system for all service points within commuting distance and book at whichever has the earliest slot

sources.title: nordicexpat.com
highlights: If family registration matters to you, check DVV's document requirements in advance — this is the single most common cause of a wasted appointment

sources.title: migrate.fi
highlights: You must bring original documents to your DVV appointment
